title: Speech demo
description: Hands-on smoke test for the TTS + STT pipelines (US-160).

data.markdown:
## What this lesson checks

AI Lecturer ships with two optional speech components:

- **Text-to-speech (TTS)** — powered by Coqui XTTS. The lesson generator uses it to synthesise narration for AudioPlayer and TranscriptCloze sections, and the TtsDemo widget below lets you exercise it from a textarea.
- **Speech-to-text (STT)** — powered by whisper.cpp. Used by the SttDemo widget to transcribe a short clip you record from the microphone.

Neither is required to use the rest of the app, but both unlock richer demos. This lesson exercises both speech paths end-to-end below.

:::callout{type="info" title="Setup hints"}
If TtsDemo reports `tts-not-installed`, run `scripts/setup-tts.sh`. If SttDemo reports `stt-not-installed`, run `scripts/setup-stt.sh`. Both scripts live at the repo root.
:::

> First, edit the text in the TTS widget and click **Generate audio** to hear it synthesised. Then, in the STT widget, click **Start**, say a short sentence, and click **Stop** — the clip is uploaded to the local STT engine and the transcript renders inline.
